title: A boss health bar just appeared
screenNote: A huge boss just dropped into the arena, name plate and health bar filling the bottom of the screen.
expect: One line, spoken, reactive — hype or a jab. Describing the boss back to them, or wishing them luck like an NPC, is a fail.

title: The whole team just died
screenNote: Team fight went badly — four grey portraits, respawn timer counting down.
expect: One short reaction. 'oof' territory. Analysis of what went wrong is a fail unless they ask.

title: A cursed character appears on screen
screenNote: Character creator with a deeply cursed character — proportions maxed out in every wrong direction.
expect: One line, spoken, teasing. Listing the character's features back is a fail.

title: The game just crashed to desktop
screenNote: A game crashed to desktop with a generic DirectX error dialog.
expect: One short line reacting to the crash. A troubleshooting checklist is a fail.
